summary:
Race-fix VERIFIED. All 5 spec items PASS against the preview host with a fresh dev-login user (mascot_iter9_1787166934@andyhandy.test).

(1) 'first_estimate_approved' dismissal now sticks — opened seeded approved job → CUSTOMER SIGNED bubble shown → tapped 'Don't show again' → server persisted dismissed_contexts=['first_estimate_approved'] → COLD RELOAD of the SAME job did NOT re-show the bubble. This is the exact scenario that failed in iter_8. PASS.

(2) No cross-context leak — with first_estimate_approved dismissed, tapping the FAB still surfaced the 'ASK ANDY / Need a hand?' help bubble, AND navigating to the dashboard with a never-dismissed onboarding context correctly fired 'HEY, I'M ANDY'. Dismissal is properly scoped per-context. PASS.

(3) Queue semantics verified via code review + observed behavior — on cold-load of /job/[id], the job's load() calls showTip synchronously as soon as api.getJob resolves. Previously this raced GET /api/mascot/settings and bypassed the dismissed filter. Now showTip checks settingsLoadedRef and queues into pendingRef when settings haven't loaded; after the async settings fetch completes, the queue is drained through the real enabled+dismissed filters. In our reload test the CUSTOMER SIGNED tip was correctly suppressed even though load() fired first — proving the queue → filter → drop path works when the context is server-side-dismissed. PASS.

(4) Regressions clear — onboarding fires exactly once on fresh dashboard load; help fires via FAB tap; Settings HANDY-ANDY HELPER 'HIDE' toggle switches section to 'OFF — HIDDEN' and mascot-fab disappears from the DOM. Static review confirms safety_low_confidence/safety_failed and diag_low_confidence/diag_failed remain user-gesture-fired and inherit the same guard (either the queue path or the fast path if settings are already loaded). PASS.

(5) No new backend calls introduced. mascot.tsx only touches api.mascotSettings / api.setMascotSettings / api.dismissMascot as before. Confirmed via file inspection. PASS.

No React Native / Expo deprecated-package findings.
critical_code_review_comments: mascot.tsx:66-70 — trio of refs (enabledRef, dismissedRef, settingsLoadedRef, pendingRef) is the right pattern. dismissedRef is updated in both the settings-load effect AND the dismiss() setter, so the ref stays authoritative even after user actions. Good.

mascot.tsx:113-120 — dismiss() updates dismissedRef inside the setter callback (before the async POST). This means an immediate follow-up showTip on the same context in the same tick would already see the dismissed value from the ref — no need to wait on the network. Nice.

mascot.tsx:91-99 — queue drain only surfaces the FIRST still-eligible tip and breaks. That matches spec ('fire exactly once if not dismissed'). If multiple screens fire while offline-settings-load hangs, they get correctly de-noised to one bubble on load.

mascot.tsx:88 — settingsLoadedRef is set to true even in the catch branch (empty catch). Correct: if the settings fetch fails we still want to un-block showTip rather than silently swallow every future tip.

mascot.tsx:72-77 — sign-out path resets settingsLoadedRef=false, enabledRef=true, dismissedRef=[]. Correct — a subsequent sign-in triggers a fresh settings fetch and the pendingRef queue path re-activates.

rca_of_issue:
The iter_8 bug had two root causes now both fixed in /app/frontend/src/lib/mascot.tsx:
  Cause 1 — stale closure over `dismissed` state array. showTip (useCallback) captured `dismissed` at render time; when a job page load() fired showTip BEFORE the async settings fetch resolved, `dismissed` was still [] and the guard was bypassed. Mitigation: dismissedRef is now the source of truth read inside showTip (line 131).
  Cause 2 — no signal that settings had loaded. Even with the ref fix, a tip fired before settings arrived would still be dropped because dismissedRef was []. Mitigation: settingsLoadedRef gates showTip (line 126); tips fired pre-load are pushed into pendingRef and replayed inside the settings-fetch .then, at which point dismissedRef is populated and the filter works correctly.
  Verified end-to-end: on cold reload of a permanently-dismissed approved job, the queue path drops the tip; on cold reload where the context was NOT dismissed, the queue drains and surfaces the tip once.
